title: A potential stack-based buffer overflow exists in ADM Defender Firewall configuration handling. (CVE-2026-120947)
description: CVE-2026-120947 is a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ADM Defender Firewall configuration handling. The flaw arises from insufficient destination-size checks and inconsistent array bounds validation during firewall policy processing. Malformed or oversized configuration data can cause out-of-bounds writes, leading to stack memory corruption. The vulnerability affects ADM versions from 4.1.0 through 4.3.3.RY62 and from 5.0.0 through 5.1.4.RM62. The CVSS score is 5.1, indicating a medium severity level.
